All-new Audi A5 What if our most important inspirations aren’t seen but felt? At Audi, our intent is
to create designs that celebrate the unseen. With the all-new 2018 Audi A5, we have
reimagined one of our most celebrated modern designs to make it sportier, smarter
and more thrilling each time you get behind the wheel. The new power dome on the
The invisible
hood speaks volumes of the potential of a new 2.0-liter 252 horsepower TFSI® engine,
while the precise yet flowing design lines create dramatic surface tension in the sheet
metal. The A5 is presented in three distinctive, refined body styles—Coupe, Cabriolet
and Sportback, a rewarding choice for those who feel as much as they think.
